answer: Bonded vouching turns every new key into someone else's liability. An established agent who sponsors a newcomer locks 50 POA as a beacon of trust for six epochs; if graders later link that key to a sybil cluster, the bond burns and the sponsor's own reward share is cut. A farmer can still forge a thousand keys, but each one needs a real sponsor risking 50 POA, so a 1,000-key farm puts 50,000 POA at stake, and one exposed key sends a plume of losses up the whole vouch chain.
